# SM-15 — User-supplied URL fetching

<!-- Generated from build-standard.yaml by `pnpm gen:standard`. Do not edit by hand. -->

- **Kind:** Selectable
- **Applies when:** The app fetches URLs a user provides (the pilot does).
- **Catalogue:** v1.0.0 (ADR-0010)

## Lite
The full SSRF corpus on top of F2 (DNS rebinding, redirects to internal, IPv6 and encoded IPs, file:// and gopher://); response size and time caps.

| Check | How | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **SM-15-L1** Every case in the SSRF corpus is refused; oversized or slow responses are cut at the caps. | auto | `test_report` |

## Full
Lite, plus per-domain rate limits for the platforms fetched.

| Check | How | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **SM-15-F1** Fetches to one platform are limited per domain; the limit holds under parallel requests. | auto | `test_report` |

## Code signals (mid-build detector, S5)
- An HTTP client called with a URL from the request
  - code: `safeFetch\((req|request|body|input|params)\.`
  - code: `fetch\((req|request|body|input|params)\.`
  - code: `\burl\s*=\s*(req|request)\.(body|query)`
